_comment: Lead-time sensitivity (Pillar et al. 2016, Fig. 1): ECCO4 prescribed-flux ocean from 1993-01, 180 days (2160 steps, ending 1993-06-30), AMOC averaged over the last 30 days, frozen mixing; tests whether the adjoint stays finite for a window that ends before the autumn blow-up seen at 1 year (3576176).
